cards.name: Jiwoo
cards.fact: Leader of the group; studied ballet for about 6–7 years before debut.

cards.name: Carmen
cards.fact: Born in Bali, Indonesia; auditioned for SM over Zoom, singing about 100 songs.

cards.name: Yuha
cards.fact: Street-cast by SM on three separate occasions and trained for about 8 years.

cards.name: Stella
cards.fact: Korean-Canadian; 32 of 60 agencies wanted to cast her in an in-house audition in Busan.

cards.name: Juun
cards.fact: Main dancer; SM scouted her through DMs after her dance videos got noticed.

cards.name: Ian
cards.fact: A former child model who appeared in SM’s 30th anniversary “The Future” video.

cards.name: Ye-on
cards.fact: The youngest member, born on April 19, 2010.

posts.title: The Chase: how Hearts2Hearts debuted in February 2025
posts.excerpt: Eight members, a two-track debut single and a record first week: what happened on February 24, 2025.
body: > This post was written by AI from the public sources listed at the bottom. Figures are as those outlets reported them.
Hearts2Hearts debuted on February 24, 2025 with the single *The Chase*. The group is an eight-member line-up from SM Entertainment: Jiwoo, Carmen, Yuha, Stella, Juun, A-na, Ian and Ye-on.
The single has two tracks, the title track “The Chase” and the B-side “Butterflies”, and it went live on music platforms at 6 PM KST on debut day.

Both events took place at Yes24 Live Hall in Gwangjin District, Seoul. The Korea Times reported a debut fan showcase called “Chase Our Hearts” at 8 PM, while SBS Star described a launch event for the single starting at 2 PM. The two outlets give different times, so the exact schedule is not confirmed here.

According to Hanteo Chart figures reported by Soompi, *The Chase* sold 408,880 copies in its first week (February 24 to March 2, 2025). That was the highest first-week total for a girl group debut album, ahead of BABYMONSTER’s 401,287 from April 2024.
- [The Korea Times: debut schedule and the “Chase Our Hearts” showcase](https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/www/art/2025/02/398_391547.html)

posts.title: FOCUS: Hearts2Hearts’ first mini album
posts.excerpt: Eight months after debut, the group returned with FOCUS and broke its own first-week sales record.
body: > This post was written by AI from the public sources listed at the bottom. Figures are as those outlets reported them.

Hearts2Hearts released its first mini album, *FOCUS*, on October 20, 2025. The Korea Times reports that the title track “FOCUS” was produced by KENZIE and that the choreography was directed by Jo Nain. A media showcase was held at Blue Square’s SOL Travel Hall in Yongsan, Seoul.

The album was preceded by the pre-release single “Pretty Please” on September 24, 2025. The digital single “STYLE” (June 18, 2025) is also on the tracklist. GenerAsia lists six tracks: FOCUS, Apple Pie, Pretty Please, Flutter, Blue Moon and STYLE. Some outlets count only five new songs because STYLE had already been released.
Hanteo Chart figures reported by Soompi put first-week sales (October 20 to 26) at 425,146 copies. That broke the group’s previous record of 408,880 set by *The Chase*.
- [The Korea Times: Hearts2Hearts zeroes in on identity with FOCUS](https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/amp/entertainment/k-pop/20251020/hearts2hearts-zeroes-in-on-identity-with-1st-mini-album-focus)

posts.title: A rookie year of awards
posts.excerpt: New Artist and Best New Artist trophies from the Melon Music Awards and MAMA in late 2025.
body: > This post was written by AI from the public sources listed at the bottom. Figures are as those outlets reported them.

The 2025 MAMA Awards were held on November 28 and 29 at Kai Tak Stadium in Hong Kong. According to CJ ENM’s report on the ceremony, Hearts2Hearts won **Best New Artist**, shared with CORTIS, and the **Olive Young K-Beauty Artist** award.

At the Melon Music Awards on December 20, 2025 at Gocheok Sky Dome in Seoul, Soompi’s winners list shows Hearts2Hearts taking **New Artist of the Year** (shared with ALLDAY PROJECT) and the **Berriz Global Fans’ Choice** award.
GenerAsia also lists a rookie award from the 34th Seoul Music Awards on June 21, 2025. That entry is from a single source in our research, so check it against the official results.

posts.title: HEARTS 2 HOUSE: first fan meeting and North American showcases
posts.excerpt: Olympic Hall in Seoul, then Brooklyn and Los Angeles: the group’s first events of 2026.
body: > This post was written by AI from the public sources listed at the bottom. Figures are as those outlets reported them.

The 2026 Hearts2Hearts Fanmeeting “HEARTS 2 HOUSE” took place on February 21 and 22, 2026 at Olympic Hall in Olympic Park, Seoul. Kyunghyang Sports described it as the group’s first standalone fan meeting since debut, with fan-club presale on December 17 and general sales on December 19, 2025 through Melon Ticket.

SM announced the North American leg on December 16, 2025. The group performed at the Brooklyn Paramount in New York on March 19, 2026 and at The Wiltern in Los Angeles on March 22. Star News and Otakukart both reported that the two shows sold out.
Both outlets also mention a “Global Spin Live” session at the GRAMMY Museum in Los Angeles on March 23 and a fan meeting in Jakarta, Indonesia on March 28. They do not name the Jakarta venue.
- [Soompi: stops for the 2026 premiere showcase in North America](https://www.soompi.com/article/1805733wpp/hearts2hearts-announces-stops-for-2026-premiere-showcase-hearts-2-house-in-north-america)

posts.title: RUDE! and Lemon Tang: the 2026 comebacks
posts.excerpt: A digital single in February, then a second mini album with the group’s best first week so far.
body: > This post was written by AI from the public sources listed at the bottom. Figures are as those outlets reported them.

The digital single “RUDE!” came out on February 20, 2026, according to GenerAsia. Star News reported that the song topped various global charts and won five music-show trophies, and the group performed it at the North American showcases.

The second mini album *Lemon Tang* was released on June 22, 2026. Star News describes the title track as dance-pop and says a showcase was held that day at Bluesquare WON Banking Hall in Yongsan, Seoul.

Soompi and Kyunghyang Sports report Hanteo first-week sales of 592,312 copies (June 22 to 28, 2026), a personal best that passed the 425,146 of *FOCUS*. Kyunghyang Sports also reports the album at No. 1 on the Circle weekly retail album chart.
- [Kyunghyang Sports: Lemon Tang becomes a half-million seller](https://sports.khan.co.kr/en/article/202606291443007)

posts.title: Japan debut with ICONIC HEART, plus the Kia and Arena of Valor collaborations
posts.excerpt: A Japanese debut single in August, then two brand collaborations in autumn 2026.
body: > This post was written by AI from the public sources listed at the bottom. Figures are as those outlets reported them.

Hearts2Hearts made its official Japanese debut with the single “ICONIC HEART”. The digital version was released on August 10, 2026 and the physical single on August 12. It has three tracks: the title track plus Japanese versions of “Lemon Tang” and “RUDE!”. A live-and-talk event in Tokyo marked the debut.

The Korea Times reports the single reached No. 2 on Oricon’s weekly singles chart and No. 2 on Billboard Japan’s Top Singles Sales with 65,176 copies in its first week. A Korean-language version followed in early October 2026.

“Moonride” was released on September 9, 2026 at 6 PM KST, a collaboration with automaker Kia celebrating the group’s selection as models for Kia’s new “Black Edition”. Soompi describes it as a night-drive concept.
## Next Chapter with Arena of Valor (October 2026)

“Next Chapter” was released on October 16, 2026 for the 10th anniversary of the mobile game Arena of Valor. Bandwagon calls it the group’s first English-language single and says the live debut was planned for October 23 in Bangkok.
